text:
Zara (partnerships): quick heads-up: launch gating checklist for the marketplace joint-announcement. primary risk is partner assets + SI creds slipping. we need a contingency plan that covers press, blog, landing, and SI preview. who can call owners for confirmations?
Owen (marketing): i'll own the press/blog pieces. i'll prepare three copy paths: partner-coannounce, partner-fallback (mentions partner but generic), and neutral. posting drafts by 12:30 PT.
Kali (product): staging link: staging.redwood.com/marketplace-beta2. missing: partner topology SVG and a short auth snippet. if those miss, i'll swap to neutral diagram. request partner provide an example curl auth snippet (token flow) or a k8s snippet.
Diego (solutions): SI preview plan: live tech preview preferred; fallback to recorded walkthrough + Q&A office hours. need sandbox creds + sample data. if creds delayed, we can do a limited demo with synthetic data.
Priya (legal): legal constraints: any partner quote must include a sign-off email. embargo clause needs a UTC timestamp. avoid superlatives unless partner confirms.
Zara (partnerships): embargo proposed Fri 17:00 UTC. partners must supply assets + signed quote by Thu 20:00 UTC. if not, we default to neutral announcement and schedule a partner spotlight post-launch.
Owen (marketing): noted. i'll prepare a fallback hero and CTA that doesn't mention partner name. also building a tiny A/B in the CMS to flip variants.
Kali (product): requested integration diagram: please include auth type, data flow (ingest -> inference -> result), and expected throughput numbers (ops/sec). small svg ok.
Diego (solutions): pinged partner at 1767701100. they said token will be issued after a security checklist completes later today. @Zara can you escalate for timeline?
Zara (partnerships): escalating now. @tickets-bot create an ops ticket and assign owners.
tickets-bot: created RED-GTM-8910 "Marketplace joint-launch contingency & assets" assigned to Owen/Kali/Diego, due 2024-08-15 20:00 UTC. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-GTM-8910
Priya (legal): checklist reminder: no partner financial claims in headline unless partner provides verified figures and signs off. if partner quote references performance, attach benchmark doc or remove claim.
Owen (marketing): draft hero variants:
```
A) "Redwood + PartnerName: inference where it matters."
B) "Ship production-grade inference with Redwood." (fallback)
C) "Try Redwood Marketplace" (neutral)
```
Posting for comments.
Kali (product): prefer B as fallback. A implies co-branding; C is safe if we lose partner assets. working on a CSS placeholder to avoid layout jumps when SVG absent.
Diego (solutions): got partial creds at 1767701215 (token only). requesting endpoint + sample data now. I'll stand up sandbox ASAP and post status.
Zara (partnerships): condensed checklist (copying into thread):
- Embargo: Fri 17:00 UTC
- Partner assets: SVG topology + logo (svg/png) -> due Thu 20:00 UTC
- Signed quote: partner email approval -> due Thu 20:00 UTC
- Hero copy variants: Owen -> 12:30 PT
- SI preview creds + sample data: Partner -> Diego -> aim today
- Fallback blog + neutral CTA: Owen -> ready if partner misses deadline
- Ticket: RED-GTM-8910

If any owner misses deadlines we flip to neutral path and schedule partner spotlight later.
Owen (marketing): will also prepare a short press fallback paragraph we can drop in under 10 minutes if needed.
Priya (legal): I'll review final quote immediately; please @Priya when partner posts signoff.
Diego (solutions): sandbox ready at 1767701290 (using partner token only, no endpoint yet). scheduling recorded demo window tomorrow 09:00 PT if endpoint not received. runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/si/marketplace-preview-runbook.md
Kali (product): deployed placeholder SVG + aspect-ratio fix at 1767701310. staging no longer jumps when logo missing.
Zara (partnerships): thanks. final rule: assets + signed quote by Thu 20:00 UTC -> proceed with partner co-announce on Fri 17:00 UTC. otherwise neutral announce + partner spotlight later. reconvene at shiproom 30m before embargo for final go/no-go. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
